question.text: Which one among the following ions, is smallest in size

solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo><</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo><</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo><</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> , All are isoelectronic species, hence effective number charge is highest for  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math>  so it has smallest size.
